entries.en: Now I am hallucinating that you are inside the tower. I must be getting worse. Earlier, I even imagined I heard thunder.
Yes, you're right. I've seen enough of them to last a lifetime. That button should shut down my containment field.
I am sorry, but I am in no mood to keep talking to a hallucination.
Of course. What good is a hallucination if it doesn't give false hope?
I am still trapped. And hungry. Please. Could we talk after you release me?
It's not like I'm going anywhere, but could you please hurry?
Are you-- Are you real? Oh no, don't be stupid, Liara. Humans do not come here. You're hallucinating.
You're oddly lucid for a hallucination. They don't usually claim to be real.
A Spectre? Ha. That's good. What else would I conjure up? A protector figure. Yes, perfect. Comforting.
Can you hear me out there? I am trapped. I need help!
Thank the Goddess! I did not think anyone would come looking for me.
Listen. This thing I am in is a Prothean security device. I cannot move, so I need you to get me out of it. All right?
It's a Prothean barrier curtain. I knew it would keep me safe from the geth.
There is a control in here that should deactivate this thing. You'll have to find some way past the barrier curtain.
I was exploring the ruins when the geth showed up, so I hid in here. Can you believe that? Geth! Beyond the Veil!
I activated the tower's defenses. I knew the barrier curtains would keep them out.
That's the tricky part. The defenses cannot be shut off from the the outside. I don't know how you'll get in here.
Be careful. There is a krogan with the geth. They have been trying different ways to get past the barrier.
Sorry. I am a little-- Look. My name is Dr. Liara T'Soni. I am an archaeologist.
How... how did you get in here? I didn't think there was any way past the barrier!
Of course. Yes. That makes sense.
There is an elevator back in the center of the tower. At least, I think it's an elevator. It should take us out of here. Come on!
We used the mining laser to bore through.
We blasted through with the mining laser.
We have to get you out of here before more geth arrive.
Any idea how I can get past this barrier curtain?
I'll find a way to get you out.
We're here to save your sorry ass. So snap out of it.
We're real enough. Stay calm. I'll get you out of there.
I'm real, and I'm getting you out of there.
Liara T'Soni, I presume.
There's some kind of repulsion field in the way.
How did you end up in there?
Any suggestions on how we can help?
Are you okay? What happened to you?
Quit shouting. This place is crawling with geth!
Not now! We have to move.
We blasted our way in.
Barrier curtain
Goodbye.
Get a grip, Doctor.
You're not hallucinating.
We're here to rescue you.
Dr. T'soni?
We hear you.
Keep it down!
How?
Trapped
What can we do?
It was easy.
It's not important.
You bored through? You're real, aren't you? By the Goddess, you're real!
I-- I'm sorry. I thought you were a hallucination. I thought I was going mad. Please get me out of here. Before more geth show up.
Any idea how we get out of this place?
Any idea how we get out of this place?
Any idea how we get out of this place?
Any idea how we get out of this place?
And talking to yourself. Ha! Oh Goddess. I'm going to die here.
Or do they? I guess I wouldn't know. I don't usually hallucinate. At least, I don't think I do.
You're rude for a hallucination. My subconscious must want to punish me for being this stupid.
When I turned it on, I must have hit something I wasn't supposed to. I was trapped in here. You must get me out. Please.
I wasn't going to let the geth capture me! Besides, I know how it works. Mostly.
How did you end up stuck in there?
My name is Shepard. The Office of Special Tactics and Recon sent me.
We just need to figure some way past this energy field.
You shouldn't have been messing with technology you don't understand.
We'll find some way to help you.
Trapped
I'm not a hallucination.
We'll find a way to free you.
We can't reach you.
You brought this on yourself.
Stay calm.
Why can't my mind conjure up something useful? Like a way out of this prison? Come on, Liara. Think!
I was exploring the ruins when the geth suddenly appeared. I ran in here to escape. I thought the barrier curtain might keep me safe.
I accidentally triggered this trap. Now I'm stuck.
I don't know. They're not meant to be shut down from the outside.
They can withstand grade-three environmental disasters. Conventional weapons won't have any effect.
You almost had me convinced there. I would not expect a hallucination to be defiant.
Well, I'll play along. As you can see, I am trapped here. If you're as real as you claim, find a way to get me out.
Ah, yes. The figment of my imagination wants me to retrace my steps. See if I can figure out where I went wrong.
I was exploring the ruins. When the geth showed up, I ran in here and activated the defenses. The barrier curtains could protect me.
I know how it works! I've studied-- Calm down, Liara. You're yelling at a figment of your imagination.
Of course. What good is a hallucination if it can't offer false hope?
Listen. If you're real, find some way past the barrier curtain. Find some way to deal with the geth.
Then use the control panel to release me. If you're not real, leave me alone. I'm tired of talking to myself.
It doesn't matter what you think. I'm getting you out of there.
Not thunder. Explosions.
That was us.
Believe me, I'm real.
Believe me, I'm real.
Fine. Don't believe me.
We can't reach you.
Superior firepower.
Please... get me out of here before more geth arrive. That button over there should shut down this containment field.
Hold on, Commander. Her mother's working with Saren. Can we trust her?
Not so fast, Shepard. You sure she's on our side? Her mother's working with Saren.
Hold on, Commander. Her mother is working with Saren. Can we trust her?
Wait, Commander. Can we trust her? Her mother's working with Saren.
I am not my mother! I don't even-- I don't know why Benezia joined Saren. I don't want anything to do with that turian bastard!
Ooff!
My mother and I don't-- I do not know why Benezia joined Saren. I don't approve of her actions. But it has nothing to do with me.
Please -- just get me out of here!
What a strange question. Am I so overshadowed by Benezia that even my own subconscious cannot separate us?
I am not my mother! I will not side with Saren.
In fact, I won't do much of anything ever again. Except die, trapped inside this containment field.
What? I am not on anybody's side!
I may be Benezia's daughter, but I'm nothing like her! I have not spoken to her in years. Please. Just get me out of here.
If she was with Saren, the geth wouldn't be trying to kill her.
Your mother works for Saren. Whose side are you on?
Your mother is working with Saren. Whose side are you on?
We need her.
I believe her.
Let her out.
Benezia
Benezia
I'll get you out.
I'll get you out.
We can't reach you.
We can't reach you.
